Practical business learning for first-time entrepreneurs.

Mission and audience

Making business understandable for beginners

Many people want to start a business but don’t know where to begin, or assume they need a lot of money. Kannada Business Adda explains business opportunities and fundamentals in plain Kannada, with a focus on practical steps and small-investment options.

The goal is simple: help you think clearly about a business, understand the basics and avoid common mistakes.

Who it’s for

  • First-time entrepreneurs
  • People who want to start a small business
  • Individuals with limited investment
  • Small business owners looking for practical ideas
  • Kannada-speaking audiences interested in entrepreneurship

Business idea consultation

A personalised business idea and plan

For people with small budgets, I’m developing a service that recommends business ideas to fit your situation: your investment budget (indicatively ₹5,000 to ₹25,000), your skills and interests, where you live and how much time you can give.

Pricing hasn’t been finalised yet, so the form below is an enquiry, not a booking or a payment.

Important: Business ideas and plans are recommendations, not guarantees of profit or success. Results depend on your effort, market conditions and circumstances.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Is this a guaranteed way to make money?

No. Business ideas and plans are recommendations based on the information you share. They are not guarantees of profit or success, and results depend on your effort, market and circumstances.

What does the personalised business idea service involve?

You tell us your investment budget, skills, interests, location, available time and preferred business type. Based on that, you receive business idea recommendations and plan guidance.

How much does it cost?

Pricing isn’t finalised yet. Use “Enquire About a Business Plan” and you’ll be told the details when they are confirmed.

What budgets do you consider?

The service is being designed for people with small budgets, with an indicative investment range of ₹5,000 to ₹25,000. This is a starting range, not a limit or a promise.

Do I need business experience?

No. The content and guidance are made for beginners.

Is the content in Kannada?

Yes. Kannada Business Adda is built for Kannada-speaking audiences, and you can write to us in Kannada or English.
